verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's core product is shareable scheduling links. Its docs say Google, Microsoft, iCloud and Fastmail calendars are all checked for conflicts, so links reflect live availability. Recipients see open times in a week view, can overlay their own calendar, and book directly, with event.created firing on each booking, which removes the email back-and-forth. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration; the only user quotes are testimonials hosted on the vendor's own site.
